meta.title: Integrate trigger.dev functions for plaid and gocardless
meta.body_summary: Integrate trigger.dev tasks for Plaid and GoCardless to offload financial data operations asynchronously with scheduled syncs, aiming to improve UI responsiveness and reliability.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor integrated trigger.dev for async financial ops; own bot flagged schema/query/env bugs; PR open with partial fix and no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2687 changed lines, this is a large change by absolute volume. It adds a substantial background task infrastructure. The PR remains open with only bot reviews and no human maintainer engagement, which is atypical for a large feature PR.

review_details.concern_detail: Cursor bot reviews identified Prisma model misuse causing schema inconsistency, incorrect relation field naming, and hardcoded Plaid sandbox environment.
review_details.performance_claim: Asynchronous processing with trigger.dev improves UI responsiveness and reliability for Plaid/GoCardless operations.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The integration required correct Prisma modeling and config management; Cursor's bot revealed gaps in schema and environment handling.

detection_detail.code_reading: Cursor bot performed static analysis and reported Prisma schema misuse, query field naming, and hardcoded environment.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark data, only narrative improvement claims.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After first review, a fix commit adjusted GoCardless schema, but second review indicates remaining issues.

core_change_summary.description: Added trigger.dev tasks for Plaid (plaid-tasks.ts) and GoCardless (gocardless-tasks.ts) with async functions and scheduled syncs, plus documentation, test actions, and a UI test button.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation and test tools account for significant portion of the changes.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added trigger tasks, documentation, removed example.ts.
Fix commit: addressed Prisma schema misuse in GoCardless tasks.
Added comprehensive test button and test guide.
Added bank connection tests for Plaid and GoCardless.
Wip commit: human edits to test button and content-collections; bot review followed with new bugs.

review_signals.summary: Flagged misuse of ConnectedAccount model causing schema inconsistency; recommended fixing.
Flagged incorrect relation field BankConnection vs bankConnections and hardcoded Plaid sandbox environment.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor agent opened PR with trigger.dev task integration, documentation, and tests.
Cursor bot reviewed and reported Prisma schema misuse; agent fixed in subsequent commit.
Agent added test UI and extended test coverage.
Human 'wip' commit and bot second review identifying additional correctness bugs.
PR remains open with unresolved issues and no human maintainer review.
